policies.name: Classify unresolved purchases
policies.instruction: Using the merchant description and existing deterministic outputs, propose only a vendor, category, subcategory, or approved reporting tags. Do not infer source facts. Leave a field unresolved when evidence is weak.

policies.name: Detect recurring subscription
policies.instruction: Mark a transaction as a subscription only when the merchant or related evidence indicates a recurring service. Add only approved subscription tags.

policies.name: Enrich property and rental unit
policies.instruction: Use explicit transaction or linked email evidence to identify the configured property and rental unit. Never guess a unit from amount alone.

policies.name: Find receipt bill or warranty evidence
policies.instruction: When the transaction is a purchase, propose an evidence search policy if matching email, receipt, invoice, bill, or warranty material may exist. The evidence worker performs the search and attachment handling.

policies.name: Enrich channel and cashback bucket
policies.instruction: Only when deterministic rules leave them unresolved, infer channel or propose a configured cashback bucket from explicit merchant, notification, wallet, currency, and card evidence. Do not calculate rewards or invent wallet usage.

policies.name: Recommend a repeated-pattern rule
policies.instruction: Only when transaction metadata contains at least three consistent reviewed examples for the same normalized merchant pattern, propose a disabled canonical static-rule draft. Include the evidence count and never execute the recommendation.
